description:
A GUI to quickly manage your WSL2 instances.


> New here? The 2.0.0 release notes carry the full picture — what WSL Manager 2 is, every feature, the download table and how Pro works. This release lists what changed since 2.5.0.
Containers
- Create a container (new): pick an image, then optionally a name, published ports, volumes, environment variables and a command — every field is one option of your engine's own run command.
- WSL's own container engine (new): on Windows with WSL 2.9.3 or later, containers from the built-in wslc engine show up next to Docker and Podman. Run wsl --update to get it. The AI assistant and the MCP server can drive it too.
AI assistant
- A redesigned chat panel: the input, Send and header buttons share one size, the input grows as you type, Send turns into Stop while the assistant works, and tool calls, tasks and messages are easier to read.
- One chat now records into one snippet. Every follow-up is added to the same snippet instead of creating a new one for each answer.
- AI Workspace: a new setting stops the ai-workspace distro from being set up automatically, so deleting it stays deleted. The AI Workspace page offers to set it up again.
macOS
- Fixes Linux VM disk corruption under heavy writes. Linux disks are now attached with full sync, one disk can never be opened by two VMs at once, a VM gets a fair chance to shut down before it is forced off, and restart waits until the disk is released.
- View console log (new): every VM's serial console is saved to a log, so a guest stuck at boot (fsck, emergency mode) can be seen from the VM row.
- A VM's IP address is only reported when the lease really belongs to it and the guest answers. Before, a stale address could stick around.
- Requires macOS 12 or later.
And
- Text from wsl.exe on a non-English Windows is no longer garbled (#322).
- A failed disk resize or sparse change now shows as an error.
- Smaller fixes and maintenance.
Downloads
Same as 2.0.0: Microsoft Store (recommended on Windows), the -setup.exe or portable .zip below, winget install Bostrot.WSLManager, and on Apple silicon the .dmg or brew install --cask wsl-manager. On Windows on ARM, pick the arm64 installer or ZIP.
Full changelog: v2.5.0...v2.6.0
